title: pi-vision config
description: <agent-dir>/extensions/vision-toolkit.json, read by the pi-vision extension and the vision-tools skill CLIs. Missing connection fields come from Pi's models.json / models-store.json, and the key from auth.json (/login).

$schema.description: Editor JSON Schema reference; not a runtime setting.

model.description: First vision model in the chain. Required: with no usable model, text-only models receive failure markers instead of images.

fallbackModels.description: Further vision models tried in order when an earlier one fails to resolve or its request fails.

imagePolicy.description: For image-capable session models: native keeps images; describe replaces all images and describe-old only older ones with the current model's own description (OpenAI Chat Completions connections only). Text-only models always get the vision chain.

lang.description: Language for image descriptions. Omitted adds no language instruction.

fallbacks.description: Legacy name for fallbackModels, read only when fallbackModels is not an array.

providers.description: Legacy per-provider connection overrides; a model entry's own fields win.

baseUrl.description: API base URL (trailing slashes removed); requests go to <baseUrl>/chat/completions. Overrides models.json.

apiKey.description: API key, or a "$ENV_NAME" reference (no brace syntax). Overrides models.json and auth.json.

protocol.description: Wire protocol for the skill CLIs. Defaults to the models.json provider api type, else chat_completions.

provider.description: Provider name. Omitted: the id is searched across models.json, models-store.json and providers entries.

thinking.description: Reasoning level sent as reasoning_effort (xhigh and max are sent as high). Omitted or off sends none.
